description: Japanese anime-style TTS service (にじボイス) from DMM-backed Algomatic, with a prepaid business API (¥825 per 10,000 characters). Algomatic announced on 2025-11-21 that the service, including the API, would end on 2026-02-04 after complaints that voices resembled real voice actors (Impress Watch, forest.watch.impress.co.jp/docs/news/1646992.html).
name: Nijivoice
